reason: A local-first visual companion that converts limited session event metadata into a draggable whale overlay with progress, statistics, achievements, and skins.

summaries.zh: 将有限的会话活动元数据转化为带有等级、统计、成就和皮肤的可拖动本地鲸鱼界面。
summaries.en: A local-first companion that turns limited session activity metadata into a draggable whale interface with levels, statistics, achievements, and skins.

capabilities: reads session identifiers, sequence numbers, event types, and timestamps
renders a draggable browser overlay and settings interface
exports and imports validated local progress records
